implementation.review: ReviewInboxPanel exposes a named review region and labelled candidate list, marks the selected version with aria-current, and keeps ArrowLeft/ArrowRight candidate navigation keyboard-operable with focus restored to the newly selected row.
implementation.generation: GenerationWorkbench exposes a named region, a labelled generation-mode group, aria-pressed mode buttons, and hides decorative mode glyphs from the accessibility tree.
implementation.projects: ProjectCreateWizard uses a modal dialog contract with aria-modal, Escape close, a bounded Tab focus loop, initial focus on the first field, and focus return to the trigger. ProjectList exposes a labelled list and aria-current selected project.
implementation.global: The application shell retains a skip link, a focus target for workspace content, visible focus outlines, and status/error announcements; this increment adds a visually hidden dialog instruction for keyboard users.

focus_semantics: review selected aria-current and arrow navigation
